title: Exchange and open/proper projection on the self-base-change square
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, e:V→W any morphism of schemes and c=(V→Z→W) a compactification [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put T=Z×_W V with q:T→V and s:T→Z, H=Dj_! and F=Rr_*H on ordinary unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write E=D(e*), L=Le*, τ:L≅E, Ex:LRr_*→Rq_*Ls*, μ:E(B⊗K)≅EB⊗EK the canonical exact tensor comparison [def-pur-supported-localization-comparisons, def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. Let P be projectionMapOfCompactification followed by F of tensoring with τ_K, and let d be the pullback of the inverse open projection, using Lq*EK→Lq*Le*K→Ls*Lr*K and the inverse tensor comparison for s. Then μ⁻¹ ; E(P) ; τ⁻¹ ; Ex_(H(M⊗EK)) equals ((τ⁻¹ ; Ex_HM)⊗1_EK) ; π_q ; Rq_*(d), where π_q is the counit-defined right-derived direct-image projection [def-kun-projection-formula-map, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor]. This is a map from EFM⊗EK to Rq_*Ls*H(M⊗EK), with no graph unit or graph transfer.

proof.text: Apply the already proved ordinary etale rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_derivedBaseChangeMap to the self-base-change square and H(M), K. Postcompose with the inverse pulled-back tensor comparison and cancel its hom.

Expand projectionMapOfCompactification. Naturality of the exact/left-derived comparison moves its inverse past the full projection composite and cancels the output hom. Naturality of derivedBaseChangeMap moves the inverse open projection, the compactification-composition map and the tensor of the exact-model comparison to the output. Substitute the exchange/projection equation from step 1.

Expand supportExactPullbackTensorIso and supportDerivedTensorIso. Cancel the pullback tensor comparison. Bifunctoriality moves the second input comparison past the tensor of exchange. Naturality of the direct-image projection moves that comparison into its pulled-back second factor. Functoriality combines the output factors into exactly sfEtaleGraphTensorMap.

theorem sfEtaleGraphExchangeTensor
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {V W : Scheme.{u}} (e : V ⟶ W) (c : Compactification e)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A V) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A W) :
    (supportExactPullbackTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e
      ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj M) K).inv ≫
      D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        (((projectionMapOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).app M).app K ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).map
            (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).map
              ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).hom.app K))) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).inv.app _ ≫
      (derivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g e).toCommSq).app _ =
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).map
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).inv.app _ ≫
        (derivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g e).toCommSq).app
            (D((c.i)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M))).app
      (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K) ≫
    ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (pullback.snd c.g e)).app
        (L((pullback.fst c.g e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
          (D((c.i)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M))).app
      (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K) ≫
    R((pullback.snd c.g e)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
      (sfEtaleGraphTensorMap A e c M K)
